_comment: Curation of the OS Characteristic-Sheet face inventory into distinct TYPEFACES, from eyeballing admin_probe/glyph_ui.html. The CS names categories, not faces: several of its categories are one typeface at different sizes, so they merge under a generic name. Faces whose held samples are unusable are dropped outright rather than left to poison a match.

_merge_notes.Italic-Solid-Serif: the generic italic serif that carries the bulk of descriptive labels
_merge_notes.county_names: county_boroughs holds no true county-borough samples — its glyphs are county_names characters, so they fold in under that name rather than being discarded

repopulate.antiq_roman: no decent samples; populate from ROAD-NAME labels, which use the same face and are abundant
